items.title: Ethiopia Guji Kercha
items.excerpt:
Region: Guji, Oromia
Varietal: Heirloom
Altitude: 1900-2100 masl
Process: Natural
Roast Profile: Medium Roast

Taste Notes: 
Coconut candy, StarFruit , Cocoa Nibs
This coffee comes from various smallholder farms around Guji region and is processed at the Banko Michicha washing station in the Kercha district. It is naturally processed with yeast-assisted controlled fermentation, to enhance its flavor complexity.

items.title: Easy Coffee Drip Bag l Single-Use Sachets
items.excerpt:
Enjoy good coffee with less time, techniques and equipments.
These individually packed coffee drip bag is perfectly measured to brew 1 cup. We use 10gram of freshly ground coffee per drip bag to ensure perfectly balance flavor cup of coffee. Perfect for travelling or to brew at home or at work.

3 flavors available (SUP, UNO, LAZ).

Step-By-Step on brewing a Drip Coffee Bag:

1. Unseal the package and hook-over-cup-filter.
2. Pull open the filter and hook each side over your favourite cup
3. Prepare 150ml of hot water. Pour in a small amount of hot water and wait for 15 seconds.
4. Slowly pour in the remaining hot water in 2-3 times and avoid overfill of water.
5. Discard the bag and enjoy.
